# MindShift Tech — Commercial Digital Marketing & Lead Generation Agency

> Premier digital marketing and customer acquisition agency based in Rawalpindi, Punjab, Pakistan. We engineer high-converting B2B lead generation pipelines, Meta Ads, Google Ads, sub-second corporate web applications, and closed-loop conversion attribution.

## Core Capabilities & Services
- **Meta Ads Management**: High-intent audience targeting across Facebook and Instagram, direct WhatsApp routing, custom lead funnels, and Conversions API (CAPI) server-side attribution.
- **Google Ads & PPC**: High-commercial intent search campaigns, Performance Max, and negative-keyword precision targeting commercial decision-makers.
- **B2B Lead Generation**: Frictionless multi-step inquiry funnels, automated qualification filters, and instant WhatsApp / phone lead routing for sales teams.
- **High-Performance Web Development**: Custom corporate websites built with zero bloated frameworks, sub-second loading speed (<0.9s), mobile-first responsive architecture, and WCAG AAA contrast compliance.
- **Search Engine Optimization (SEO)**: Local SEO for Rawalpindi & Islamabad, commercial-intent keyword ranking, Google Business Profile optimization, and technical search infrastructure.
- **Social Media Marketing**: Brand positioning, video production (YouTube & Instagram Reels), and organic authority building.
- **Conversion Tracking & Attribution**: Google Analytics 4 (GA4), Google Tag Manager (GTM), Meta CAPI, and closed-loop attribution measuring true marketing ROI.

## Target Commercial Sectors
- Commercial Waterproofing & Structural Repair Contractors
- Construction Chemicals & Polymer Admixture Manufacturers
- Specialist Trade, MEP & Engineering Contractors
- Growing Commercial B2B & Industrial Enterprises

## Verified Agency Proof
- **+180%** Qualified Inquiries achieved for Commercial Waterproofing contractor
- **-42%** Cost Per Lead (CPL) reduction through high-intent search restructuring
- **<0.8s** Mobile Page Speed delivering frictionless user experience
